products.name: Ross 308 Broiler Day-old Chicks
products.tagline: Vifaranga vya kuku wa nyama (Ross 308) kutoka Harsho Chicks, Moshi.
products.description:
Day-old Ross 308 broiler chicks from the Harsho hatchery in Moshi, hatched from Harsho's own broiler breeder flock.

• Vaccinated against Marek's disease and Newcastle disease at the hatchery, with a health certificate for every batch
• Fresh hatch every Friday: book at least one week ahead
• Minimum order 50 chicks
• Delivered in ventilated chick boxes, or collected from Harsho
• Ready for market in about 35–42 days with good management

Ask the farm assistant how to prepare the house, brooding temperatures, feeding and lighting: it answers from the Ross Broiler Handbook.

products.name: Ross 308 Broiler Hatching Eggs
products.tagline: Mayai ya kutotolesha ya kuku wa nyama (Ross 308) kutoka shamba la wazazi la Harsho.
products.description:
Fertile Ross 308 broiler hatching eggs from Harsho's own broiler breeder flock in Moshi, for farmers and hatcheries with their own incubators. Harsho reports a fertility rate above 90%. Incubation takes 21 days.

Book ahead with Harsho; collection or delivery is arranged with the hatchery.
